name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. This parameter is required for traditional dedicated instances and optional for VPC-integrated dedicated instances
parameters.help_zh: 可用区，专享实例类型为传统类型专享实例为必填项，VPC融合类型专享实例可以不填
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

If PricingCycle is set to Month, the value ranges from 1 to 9.
If PricingCycle is set to Year, the value ranges from 1 to 3.

This parameter is available and required only when ChargeType is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
实例包年包月的时间，取值：

PricingCycle为Month，表示按月付费，取值范围为1~9。
PricingCycle为Year，表示按年付费，取值范围为1~3。

ChargeType取值为PrePaid时，本参数可用且必须传入
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle of the subscription instance. Valid values:

year: year
month: month

This parameter is required when ChargeType is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或包月类型，取值范围如下：

year：年
month：月

若付费类型为PrePaid，该参数为必传参数
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment for renewals. Valid values:
True: Automatic payment is enabled. Make sure that your account has sufficient balance.
False: Manual payment is required. You can log on to the console, choose Billing > User Center in the upper-right corner, and pay for the order on the Orders page.

Default value: False
parameters.help_zh:
续费时是否自动付费。取值：
True：自动付费。请确保账号有足够的余额。
False：控制台手动付费。具体操作为：登录控制台，在右上角选择费用>进入费用中心，在订单管理找到目标订单进行支付。

默认值：False
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Do not reuse the token. If the token string contains leading or trailing spaces, the spaces are automatically trimmed by the gateway
parameters.help_zh: 口令，是用来做防止重复提交请求的，请勿重复使用。如果Token字符串的前后包含空格，空格会被网关自动删除（Trim）
parameters.name: token

parameters.help_en:
The type of the dedicated instance. Valid values:
vpc_connect: VPC-integrated dedicated instance.
normal: traditional dedicated instance.

<notice>This parameter is in invitational preview and is not available.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
专享实例类型
vpc_connect：VPC融合类型专享实例
normal：传统类型专享实例

<notice>该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用。></notice>
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block of the instance. This parameter is required when the dedicated instance type is VPC-integrated. Valid values:
192.168.0.0/16
172.16.0.0/12

<warning>A VPC-integrated dedicated instance connects to the specified CIDR block. To prevent IP address conflicts, make sure that the specified CIDR block does not overlap with the private IP addresses of your cloud services.</warning>
<notice>This parameter is in invitational preview and is not available.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
专享实例类型为VPC融合专享实例时，实例所在网段
192.168.0.0/16
172.16.0.0/12

<warning>VPC融合专享实例会连接您指定的网段，请尽量避开冲突，以防出现云产品的私网IP和您指定网段下云服务IP冲突的情况></warning>
<notice>该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用。></notice>
parameters.name: instance_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user VPC to be connected. This parameter is required when the dedicated instance type is VPC-integrated.
<notice>This parameter is in invitational preview and is not available.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
专享实例类型为VPC融合专享实例时，需要连通的用户VPC ID
<notice>该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用。></notice>
parameters.name: user_vpc_id

fields.help_en: The IPv4 CIDR block of the vSwitch
fields.name: cidr_block

fields.help_en: The security group ID. Services in the same security group can access each other
fields.help_zh: 安全组的ID，同一个安全组内的服务可以互相访问
fields.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone, vSwitch, and security group information required for network connectivity. This parameter is required when the dedicated instance type is VPC-integrated.
<notice>This parameter is in invitational preview and is not available.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
专享实例类型为VPC融合专享实例时，需要连通网络所需要的可用区，虚拟交换机以及安全组信息
<notice>该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用。></notice>
parameters.name: zone_vswitch_security_group
